title: Emailing selected contacts, and sending an email as 1:1 conversations, are built and gated but nothing in the UI offers them.

source.ref: Whole-site audit 2026-11-16 (project thread, requested by Daniel). Confidence: CONFIRMED. Audit file: audit/FINAL-BUILD-AND-REPAIR-LIST-2026-11-16.md

detail:
EVIDENCE: lib/spaces/email-drafts.ts:546 sendSpaceEmailDraftToRecipients and :610 sendSpaceEmailDraftAsConversations have zero non-test callers; components/spaces/marketing/space-send-panel.tsx:63 only calls sendSpaceEmailDraft with an audience filter.

WHY IT MATTERS: An owner cannot pick three people from the CRM and send them one designed email or start conversations; the only path is segment/tag blasts. The send-gate hardening (SCAN-866, LIVE-727) protects code nobody reaches.

FIX DIRECTION: Add a Send to selected action on the CRM roster that opens the compose popup with the recipient list, or delete the two senders.

CLOSED 2026-11-16: two entry points, both behind the existing gates and never auto-sending. (1) CRM People roster: checkboxes plus an Email selected bar (editors only) that opens the existing member composer pre-filled with the picked people as removable chips; it sends as 1:1 conversations through sendSpaceEmailDraftAsConversations after a confirm. (2) The Space email Send panel gains Or send to specific people: pick contacts by name, choose One email each (sendSpaceEmailDraftToRecipients) or 1:1 conversations, two confirms, no undo. The search action now returns the contact id so conversations find their counterparty. No gate changed.

verify.note: Fails on 2026-11-16 (audit run). Passes when the fix lands. Audit-written probes are direction checks; retime only with Daniel's phrase.
